race.comment: MATERIALIST (8) showed little early speed last start and failed to come on in the straight when seventh, beaten 4.5 lengths, over 1400m at Townsville. Going up a level this time but she deserves another chance. LOWLANDS (6) did little and finished 4.5 lengths from the winner in eighth over 1400m at Townsville last start, a less impressive effort than her fourth there the run before. Will enjoy a drop in class so she is perfectly placed to score. The well-related NEW HAMPSHIRE (3) (half to G1 winner Levendi) finished ninth last start over 1250m at this track after racing on the pace for much of the way. Will push forward and is among the chances. ADMITTED (1) missed the frame last time when 11th over 1000m at Townsville. Prior to that had won two races on end, the last of those at this venue. Likely to push forward and race on the pace. Deserves respect on best figures.
